title: Environmental Recycling Fee
body_html:
Why is there an Environmental Recycling Fee?


One day, your Aventon e-bike battery will reach the end of its useful life. When that happens, the battery must be handled and recycled properly to protect the environment, people, and property
Aventon partners with The Battery Network, an industry-wide battery recycling program, to ensure e-bike batteries are safely and responsibly recycled and kept out of landfills. To support this program, a $15 Environmental Recycling Fee (ERF)* is collected for each battery, where applicable.


This fee helps cover the administration of the battery recycling program, including:
-Certified battery recycling and safe disposal
-Recycling kits and safety materials
-Transportation and logistics
-Consumer education and compliance with recycling regulations


When it’s time to recycle your Aventon e-bike battery, simply drop it off at an Aventon authorized retailer participating in The Battery Network program.

* Effective October 1, 2026, an Environmental Recycling Fee of $10 per battery applies to orders shipped to Connecticut. Orders shipped to Alaska, Hawaii, Puerto Rico, and Catalina Island, California, are exempt from this fee.

* The Environmental Recycling Fee may or may not apply depending on your shipping destination.

The Aventon Swing Away Extension is your solution for hauling bikes around while keeping easy access to your trunk, truck bed, or trailer. The Extension has a 90 degree rotation for easy access to your vehicle without unloading the rack. With a sturdy steel construction and 2" hitch mount, this hitch adapter is built to keep your bikes safe while you're on the road. 

 

Key Features:

  • Sturdy Steel Construction: Designed for durability and reliability, the steel construction ensures a robust and long-lasting performance.

  • Universal Compatibility: Mounts effortlessly to any vehicle and rack with a 2” hitch receiver, offering versatile use for various transportation needs.

  • Integrated Anti-Wobble Safety System (Patented): Experience a stable and secure ride even on bumpy and rough roads, thanks to our patented anti-wobble technology that keeps your load steady.

  • 90-Degree Rotation: Gain full access to your vehicle's hatch without unloading your bikes or cargo. The swing-away extension rotates a full 90 degrees, providing convenience and flexibility.

  • Secure Locking Mechanism: Easily toggle the clamp to lock the swing arm securely, ensuring a firm and stable hold throughout your journey.

 

Not Suitable for RVs and fifth wheels.

The HUD-Y doesn't skimp on ventilation thanks to the two large vents and channels built into the foam that pulls air over the head. The feature that takes the helmet to the next level is the magnetically attached, USB rechargeable, rear LED light. In addition to classic color designs, there are also signal and a wide range of fashion forward options. For those that want to show up to their destination in style, there is no better option than the ABUS HUD-Y.

 

Features

  • Multi-position visor for excellent air circulation and protection from the sun.
  • Wide-angle LED light with high power and magnetic attachment
  • Depending on the mode, the light has a maximum luminosity of nine lumens. The four modes are Eco Mode, Power Mode and Blink Mode and pulsing
  • LED light recharges quickly via micro USB. The color of the LED indicates when the charging process is finished
  • ActiCage: Reinforcement of the helmet structure, which is integrated into the EPS hard foam of a helmet. The cage architecture creates space for large vents openings.
  • FidLock magnetic buckle
  • Laterally adjustable, non-slip TriVider strap system

 

Size Guide

  • Small - Head Circumference: 51-55cm
  • Medium - Head Circumference: 52-58cm
  • Large - Head Circumference: 57-61cm

 

How to measure my size?

Helmet sizes are based on head circumference. Measure your size by wrapping a measuring tape snugly around the widest possible circumference - from the most prominent part of the forehead (often 1-2 fingers above the eyebrow) around to the widest part of the back of your head. Measure 3 times, and take the largest number. Using the chart above, select your size.
